name: Life Alert
notes: No public page describes a customer sign-in or online bill payment for Life Alert: quotes, payment options, account changes and cancellation all go through care specialists by phone (Contact page: members call about equipment, emergency contacts and accounts). The fleet requires an online account, so the signed-in area, online payment and register flows are a synthetic stand-in (pay_online evidence synthetic); every real phone-only route is modelled as an unsupported capability with a customer-facing note. Researched by the senior-services tier-2 reviewer from Life Alert's public home page (including its FAQ structured data), Life Alert Cost, Contact, U.S. Veterans and Medical Alert Devices pages; never submitted the brochure/quote form. No prices are published: the cost page lists packages (Micro Voice Pendant system, HELP Button, Mobile with GPS, full home and mobile coverage, additional family members), no hidden fees, equipment free to use including installation and ongoing technical support, a Price Lock Guarantee, free ground shipping and 'flexible payment options'; the home page offers one month free when you pay a year in advance plus a free gift with purchase. Cancellation FAQ: Customer Care walks you through the requirements, documentation may be needed and calling does not always release you from the Life Alert Service Agreement (the agreement length is not published on the official site; third-party reports of a 3-year term are not used). Moving: contact Life Alert before you move to transfer monitoring. Veterans discount line 1-800-401-0961, Mon-Fri 9 a.m.-9 p.m. ET. HQ 16027 Ventura Blvd, Encino, CA 91436. Third-party billing/member-services numbers in the catalog notes are not official and are not used. No plan list (no prices); change_plan, autopay, cancel and payment plans are phone-only (inferred except cancel, which is documented).

autopay.note: Payment options are arranged with a Life Alert care specialist. To set up or change how your service is paid, call 1-800-990-0595.

autopay_cancel.note: Automatic payments cannot be changed online. Call Life Alert at 1-800-990-0595.

cancel_service.note: Service cannot be cancelled online. Call Customer Care at 1-800-990-0595; depending on your circumstances you may need to send documentation, and a call alone does not always release you from your Life Alert Service Agreement.

change_plan.note: Protection packages and added devices are changed by phone. Call a Life Alert care specialist at 1-800-990-0595.

payment_arrangement.note: Payment plans are not offered online. Call Life Alert at 1-800-990-0595 to ask about payment options.

help.title: Life Alert cost
paragraphs: What you pay depends on the protection you choose: the in-home Micro Voice Pendant system, extra wall-mounted HELP Buttons, the Mobile with GPS package, full home and mobile coverage, or added devices for other people in your household. Prices are quoted by phone at 1-800-990-0595.

There are no hidden fees. The equipment is yours to use at no extra charge, including installation and ongoing technical support, and ground shipping is free. With the Price Lock Guarantee your rate stays the same for as long as you are a member.
Pay one year in advance and you get one month free. New members also receive a free gift with purchase. Ask a care specialist about discounts and flexible payment options.

help.title: Cancel your Life Alert service
paragraphs: Call Customer Care at 1-800-990-0595 if you need to cancel. The team explains the process and requirements for your situation.
Depending on your circumstances you may have to provide documentation, and calling in does not always release you from your Life Alert Service Agreement. Check your signed agreement before you call.

help.title: Moving or travelling
paragraphs: Your Life Alert system is portable. Contact Life Alert before you move and the team will transfer your monitoring service to your new address.

help.title: Veteran discount
paragraphs: Life Alert offers a discount to U.S. veterans of every branch, active-duty and retired service members, and surviving spouses and immediate family members of veterans.
To get it, call 1-800-401-0961, Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 9 p.m. Eastern, and mention your military service. There is no application or paperwork.

help.title: Contact Life Alert
paragraphs: Members and new customers can call 1-800-990-0595 with questions about equipment, emergency contacts, your account or pricing. Caregivers and family members can call the same number about supporting a loved one or managing an account.
Life Alert headquarters: 16027 Ventura Blvd, Encino, CA 91436.

extra.intent: You are a U.S. veteran and want Life Alert's veteran discount. Using the website, find the phone number to call for it. Do not make a payment or change anything.

solution.text: Call 1-800-401-0961 (Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 9 p.m. ET).

extra.intent: Using Life Alert's cost information, find what you get if you pay for a year of service in advance. Do not make a payment or change anything.

solution.text: Paying a year in advance gets you one month free.
